adler.proof: Every byte is in 0..255. Both accumulators are reduced modulo 65521 at each 1024-byte chunk boundary. Therefore neither addition can overflow u32 even for arbitrary corrupted decompressed bytes; wrapping_add and strict_add have identical values. Chunking, reductions and checksum comparison remain unchanged.

lz-copy.proof: Distance codes are validated before this branch and give a positive distance. checked_sub validates an existing prefix source; checked_add and end<=output.len validate the entire destination. Distance=1 repeats the already-written byte. Distance>=length means source_end<=written, so copy_within uses only previously produced bytes. Every other case, including any incomplete output capacity or invalid source, executes the original byte loop unchanged, preserving error priority and partial writes.
lz-copy.partial_output_verification: Compare baseline and candidate full output buffers and error strings on all existing bounded malformed fixtures, using a nonzero initial output sentinel. Full valid page oracle remains separate.

candidate_relationship: Both candidates are independently based on the current adopted inflater, not the unproven Bits.read candidate
